name: Chroma Subsampling
definition: A technique to reduce bitrate by subsampling chrominance components (U, V) while keeping luminance (Y) at full resolution, improving color quality at low bitrates.
summary: Chroma subsampling reduces volumetric color bitrate by storing one median chroma value per eight-voxel block while keeping luminance at full resolution, preventing grey artifacts common in direct subsampling.
